topic: content strategy and point of view
text: Most B2B content fails for a boring reason. It has nothing to say. We published twice a week for a year. Traffic went up. Pipeline did not move. Then we cut output in half and put one real opinion in every post. Pipeline moved in six weeks. Volume is not a strategy. A point of view is.

A prospect told me last week she found us through ChatGPT. Not Google. ChatGPT. She asked it which tools solved her problem. We were named. Three competitors were not. AI search is a right-now problem. The companies getting named wrote clear, specific answers to the exact questions buyers ask. Everyone else is invisible and does not know it yet.
Hiring rule I wish I had learned earlier: hire the person who ships, not the person who plans. Planners give you a deck. Shippers give you a result by Friday.
